name: She Leads Change
line: With EMpower: over 50 adolescent girls from Jagdamba, on agency and decision-making, since 2017.
deck: A year-long journey with adolescent girls from one Delhi settlement. Fifty of them so far, and an award we cannot yet explain.

figures.label: Adolescent girls through the year-long journey
Girls in the wider Learning Communities cohort
Girls recognised by the ELC Bright Promise Award

how.p: The journey runs a full year with the same group of adolescent girls, on agency and decision-making. A year is long enough for a fifteen-year-old's circumstances to change twice, which is the point of staying that long.
The girls sit inside a wider Learning Communities cohort, run with EMpower. The unit is the community rather than the individual — which is the difference between this and a scholarship.

done.p: Through the whole year-long journey, from Jagdamba.
Fifty-seven girls. We hold the award and the number, and not the citation.

holes.what: We know the award and how many girls were in it. We do not know what the 2018 ELC Bright Promise Award was given for.
We can say how many girls have been through this since 2017. We cannot say how many are in it now.
holes.unlocks: A current cohort size — which is the difference between a live programme and a total.

holes.what: This runs on the same settlement, with the same partner, in the same age group as ME to WE, and we have not said how the two differ.
